candidates.title: SIR row: Nadda backs EC, sends message to Rahul Gandhi and opposition
candidates.excerpt: Union minister JP Nadda has attacked opposition leaders including Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal, and Akhilesh Yadav. He accused them of trying to undermine the Election Commission's integrity and spreading falsehoods. Nadda emphasized that their tactics reflect a mindset aimed at causing confusion and disruption in the country. Meanwhile, oppposition demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
